pack: Roblox R6 asset pack for RobloxShorts
axes: +Y up; characters face -Z; +X is the character's right; OBJ coordinates are relative to each item's pivot

studio.place: Copy of Steal a Beast Egg! (placeId 121299808702869)

colour: MTL Kd/Ks/Ke are sRGB; materials with Ke are Roblox Neon; overlays (decals/textures/face) use alpha with d 0.999

list.name: neutral

list.name: sad

list.name: laugh
list.description: Closed happy eyes, wide open mouth with tongue.

list.name: smug
list.description: Half-lidded eyes, one raised brow, sideways smirk.

list.name: evil_grin
list.description: Angry brows, narrowed eyes, big toothy Epic-style grin.

list.name: scheming
list.description: Narrow sideways-lidded eyes, low brows, long sly grin.

list.name: scared
list.description: Worried brows, big eyes with highlights, wobbly open mouth.

list.name: crying
list.description: Squeezed shut eyes, tear streams, wailing mouth.

list.name: dizzy
list.description: Spiral eyes, wavy mouth.

list.name: confused
list.description: One brow up, one flat, off-centre squiggle mouth.

list.name: annoyed
list.description: Deadpan: flat brows, half-lidded eyes, short flat mouth.

list.name: shocked
list.description: White eyes with tiny pupils, high brows, gasp.

list.name: determined
list.description: Low slanted brows, lidded eyes, clenched teeth.

list.name: wink
list.description: One eye closed, classic smile.

list.name: sleeping
list.description: Closed relaxed eyes, small open snoring mouth.

list.name: nervous
list.description: Worried brows, wobbly smile, sweat drop.

list.name: love
list.description: Heart eyes, open smile.

list.name: cool
list.description: Black sunglasses with glints, confident smirk.

list.name: blink
list.description: Eyes closed with the classic smile; use for blinks.

list.name: suspicious
list.description: One narrowed eye with a low brow, one raised brow, small side mouth.

list.name: shouting
list.description: Angry brows, big open yelling mouth with teeth and tongue.

list.name: knocked_out
list.description: X eyes, small open mouth with tongue out.

list.name: disgusted
list.description: One squeezed eye, one lidded eye, wavy frown with tongue out.

list.name: talking
list.description: Default eyes, medium open mouth.

list.name: mouth_closed
list.description: Lip-sync: closed (M, B, P) - soft smile line.

list.name: mouth_small
list.description: Lip-sync: small open (most consonants).

list.name: mouth_wide
list.description: Lip-sync: wide open (A, I).

list.name: mouth_o
list.description: Lip-sync: rounded O (O, U, W).

list.name: mouth_e
list.description: Lip-sync: wide smile showing teeth (E, EE).
